corrections.name: Meditation
corrections.reason: Batch 243 incorrectly treated a reinforcement interaction window as Meditation's base duration. Current/recent community documentation consistently describes Meditation's own buff as lasting 60 seconds; the approximately 20-second figure applies to interactions where another reinforcement skill overwrites or shortens the active reinforcement window. Steam community testing explicitly reports Meditation's buff lasting 60 seconds, while GameFAQs testing documents the 20-second interaction when Divinity Unleashed is activated afterward.

retained.unlock_method: Parallel Quest 122 - The Final Battle Before the Final Battle?!
retained.effect: Raises maximum Ki and provides automatic Ki regeneration

research_note: Do not encode reinforcement-stacking/overwriting behavior as the skill's intrinsic duration. Meditation's base duration is 60 seconds; specific combinations can shorten the effective duration of one or both reinforcement effects.
